lessons.text: A task's Done-when note that defers an acceptance criterion to a later feature does not amend the spec - confirm the spec itself still assigns that AC to the current feature before treating the deferral as settled, or edit the spec's AC and traceability explicitly.

lessons.text: Every line in a spec's Edge Cases section needs an owning task in tasks.md - an edge case with no task assigned to it typically ships unimplemented and untested.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a value object s own passing unit tests or a sibling handler exercising the identical call pattern do not substitute for a dedicated test on the specific handler or route that also calls it give every error producing call site its own asserting test at the layer the test coverage matrix promises for that route
lessons.text: A value object's own passing unit tests, or a sibling handler exercising the identical call pattern, do not substitute for a dedicated test on the specific handler or route that also calls it - give every error-producing call site its own asserting test at the layer the Test Coverage Matrix promises for that route.
evidence: CVR-01-AC7 (register-customer.handler.spec.ts has no malformed-address/phone case) (application-handlers)

update-service.handler.spec.ts (no case renaming a service to a name only a deactivated service holds, even though service.repository.spec.ts:85-94 proves the identical existsActiveByName call shape) (application-handlers)

inventory-items.controller.ts POST/PATCH/:externalId/adjustments (inventory:manage) - only the /replenishments route got a dedicated mechanic-403 e2e case (test/e2e/inventory-items.e2e.spec.ts:112-123); create/update/adjust and the read-routes-with-neither-permission branch (INV-01 AC9) rest on the same decorator with no route-specific case (application-handlers)

create-inventory-item.request.dto.ts:24 (@IsIn(['PART','SUPPLY'])) and replenish/adjust DTOs' @IsPositive quantity guard (INV-01 AC2, INV-02 AC4) - no test at any layer asserts the DTO-level 400 for an invalid kind or a zero/negative movement quantity over HTTP, though the identical global ValidationPipe mechanism is proven for other DTOs elsewhere in the codebase (application-handlers)

WOP-01 AC6 (404), WOP-01 AC10 and WOP-03 AC5 (422): the aggregate's unit tests at work-order.spec.ts:1035/1063/1255 plus the ErrorKind mapping are the only evidence; no e2e asserts the status on the withdrawals or returns route (e2e-routes)

lessons.key: gate_fail::a per call test fixture generator built from limited entropy randomness a faker field a random digit checksum id can still collide against a never truncated test database once enough runs accumulate prefer a uuid derived fragment in fixture generators over independent random digits or a library default with bounded entropy
lessons.text: A per-call test-fixture generator built from limited-entropy randomness (a faker field, a random-digit checksum id) can still collide against a never-truncated test database once enough runs accumulate - prefer a UUID-derived fragment in fixture generators over independent random digits or a library default with bounded entropy.
evidence: test/support/http.ts:26-28 (registerUser's faker email / document.factory.ts's uniqueValidCpf) - 409 collision observed on the first full gate run, gone on immediate rerun (test-fixtures)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a promise all raced two transaction test against a real database is not a reliable discrimination sensor for a dropped row lock by itself because two independent read then write calls do not always interleave measure a concurrency sensor s mutation kill rate across several repeated runs before trusting a single pass or fail
lessons.text: A Promise.all()-raced two-transaction test against a real database is not a reliable discrimination sensor for a dropped row lock by itself, because two independent read-then-write calls do not always interleave - measure a concurrency sensor's mutation kill rate across several repeated runs before trusting a single pass or fail.
evidence: typeorm-inventory-item.repository.ts:68 (pessimistic_write lock removed) against test/integration/inventory-item.repository.spec.ts:199-226's Promise.all()-raced concurrent-replenishment test - failed 3/15 runs (~20%) under the mutation, 0/2 false-positive on the unmutated tree across two full test:integration gate runs (concurrency-tests)

lessons.key: ac_gap::every read route not only write routes needs its own 403 test using an actor that genuinely lacks that route s permission a suite where every e2e actor happens to hold the read permission leaves the lacks read permission criterion completely untested
lessons.text: Every read route, not only write routes, needs its own 403 test using an actor that genuinely lacks that route's permission - a suite where every e2e actor happens to hold the read permission leaves the 'lacks read permission' criterion completely untested.
evidence: spec.md WO-05 AC6 / test/e2e/work-orders.e2e.spec.ts (no case) (e2e-routes)

lessons.key: ac_gap::an edge case s task assignment in a tasks md edge case ownership table is not sufficient by itself the owning task s own done when checklist must also list that edge case as a line item or it can ship correctly implemented but with zero test evidence
lessons.text: An edge case's task assignment in a tasks.md Edge Case Ownership table is not sufficient by itself - the owning task's own Done-when checklist must also list that edge case as a line item, or it can ship correctly implemented but with zero test evidence.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when two layers enforce the same rule the outer guard needs a test the inner guard cannot satisfy otherwise loosening or deleting the outer one changes behaviour that no test can see
lessons.text: When two layers enforce the same rule, the outer guard needs a test the inner guard cannot satisfy - otherwise loosening or deleting the outer one changes behaviour that no test can see.
evidence: M3: work-order.ts:473 (planned-quantity guard loosened by one) survived work-order.spec.ts:1108 and the whole unit suite, because work-order-part-item.ts:75 enforces the same rule (domain-aggregates)

N1: work-order.ts:447 (returnParts' outer below-zero guard loosened to < -1) survived the full src/modules/work-orders unit suite, because work-order-part-item.ts:85 enforces the same rule (domain-aggregates)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::give every threshold comparison a fixture sitting exactly on its boundary fixtures that clear the threshold by a margin on both sides cannot tell a strict comparison from a non strict one
lessons.text: Give every threshold comparison a fixture sitting exactly on its boundary - fixtures that clear the threshold by a margin on both sides cannot tell a strict comparison from a non-strict one.
evidence: M7: typeorm-inventory-query.adapter.ts:65 (HAVING SUM(...) > quantity_on_hand changed to >=) survived stock-shortages.query.spec.ts and both e2e specs (query-adapters)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an acceptance criterion names several fields a record must carry assert every one of them a not null column with a foreign key proves a value is present never that it is the right one
lessons.text: When an acceptance criterion names several fields a record must carry, assert every one of them - a NOT NULL column with a foreign key proves a value is present, never that it is the right one.
evidence: WOP-01 AC2 and WOP-03 AC2 (the acting user on a CONSUMPTION and on a RETURN movement has no assertion; inventory-item.repository.spec.ts:334 covers only INBOUND) (persistence)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::give every term of a computed formula a fixture where it is non zero a term left at its identity value is indistinguishable from a term that is not in the expression at all
lessons.text: Give every term of a computed formula a fixture where it is non-zero - a term left at its identity value is indistinguishable from a term that is not in the expression at all.
evidence: N3: typeorm-inventory-query.adapter.ts:57,65 (SUM(planned_quantity - withdrawn_quantity) reduced to SUM(planned_quantity)) survived all 880 tests, because every shortage fixture leaves withdrawn_quantity at 0 (WOP-04 AC2) (query-adapters)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when one computed expression both filters rows and fills a returned field assert the returned field s value on a row the filter admits a membership only assertion proves the filter s copy of the expression and never the projection s
lessons.text: When one computed expression both filters rows and fills a returned field, assert the returned field's value on a row the filter admits - a membership-only assertion proves the filter's copy of the expression and never the projection's.
evidence: P1: typeorm-inventory-query.adapter.ts:57 (the shortage projection alone reduced to SUM(planned_quantity), the HAVING clause at :65 intact) survived all 882 tests, because the only fixture with a non-zero withdrawn quantity asserts absence from the list rather than the reported figure (WOP-04 AC2) (query-adapters)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::assert a pointer field in a fixture with more than one possible target a single candidate fixture passes for any resolution logic right or wrong
lessons.text: Assert a pointer field in a fixture with more than one possible target - a single-candidate fixture passes for any resolution logic, right or wrong.

lessons.text: Give every aggregate function a fixture whose group holds more than one row - an aggregate over a single row returns that row whatever the aggregate is.
